title: Winter Residencies
host_org: Snow Farm: The New England Craft Program
source_quote: Our January through March Winter Residencies are for artists who enjoy a snowy landscape and whose creativity blossoms in the deep quiet of winter. Accommodations are in the cozy cottage and residency periods are for one week – students can come for as many weeks as they like.
evidence_sentence: Winter residencies (Jan–Mar) give artists access to all studios including ceramics with raku, gas reduction, and pit firing.
evidence_quote: upgraded electricity for the outdoor kiln deck which includes a raku kiln, Bailey gas kiln, and pit firing area
summary: Week-long winter residencies (Jan–Mar) allow artists to work independently in any studio, including ceramics with raku, gas reduction, and pit firing access.
